function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT vendor_id, sku, period, SUM(qty) as qty FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09') GROUP BY vendor_id, sku, period ORDER BY vendor_id, sku, period","purpose":"Purchase quantity by vendor, SKU, period"}
